736:t_1:486.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So... let's fight with all our strength together.」

736:t_1:488.en:
$$カレン$$
「Now that we've made up our minds, let's hear from you too, $n.」

736:t_1:489.en:
$$シン$$
「What do you want to do when peace comes?」

736:t_1:492.en:
$$クラン$$
「You're agreeing to it!? You stubbornly refused no matter how much everyone suggested it!」

736:t_1:493.en:
$$アルト$$
「What brought on this change of heart?」

736:t_1:494.en:
$$甲児$$
「Are you changing your look to go with giving up being the quiet type?」

736:t_1:496.en:
$n
(I don't need to keep chasing Mom's image anymore...)

736:t_1:497.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Do you have anything else in mind, like a dream for the future?」

736:t_1:498.en:
$n
「I wrote '$$ビーストハンター$$' on the school's career survey, but...」

736:t_1:499.en:
$$竜馬$$
「What will you do in the hunting off-season?」

736:t_1:500.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I think you'd make a good test pilot now, $n. Your piloting skills have come a long way.」

736:t_1:501.en:
$$ランド$$
「No, no...! Your attention to detail and tenacity are perfect for a repairman!」

736:t_1:502.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Your field skills would work in a city too... How about being a stylish private detective with me? I'll pay you reasonably well.」

736:t_1:504.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ランド$$ trained your spirit, $$セツコ$$ your technique, and $$クロウ$$ your body, $n. You should be able to aim for great heights.」

736:t_1:505.en:
$n
「Spirit, technique, and body... Maybe I should aim to become a sumo grand champion.」

736:t_1:506.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your growth shows in the simulation results too, $n.」

736:t_1:507.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your overall record is 224 wins and 387 losses.」

736:t_1:508.en:
$n
「I've got way more losses than wins...」

736:t_1:509.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You were a complete amateur at first. But counting only your record since the $$時獄戦役$$, you have 144 wins and 145 losses.」

736:t_1:513.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You could make a good test pilot.」

736:t_1:514.en:
$$ランド$$
「No, no...! He'll be a passionate repairman!」

736:t_1:515.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's not it. He'll be a hard-boiled private detective.」

736:t_1:516.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Honestly! This isn't the time to talk about that!」

736:t_1:517.en:
$n
「You're right... We're about to fight the $$御使い$$s...」

736:t_1:518.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's not what I mean, $n...! Do you think you can graduate with things as they are!?」

736:t_1:520.en:
$$宗介$$
「Exactly, $n. Our fight will go on even after we restore peace.」

736:t_1:521.en:
$$甲児$$
「This is bad. We promised everyone in Class 2-4 we'd graduate together.」

736:t_1:523.en:
$n
「Let's make it back alive and win our future!」

736:t_1:525.en:
$n
「What will you do when the fighting ends, Miss $$スズネ$$?」

736:t_1:526.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'll become a teacher, of course.」

736:t_1:527.en:
$n
「But before the final battle with the $$アンチスパイラル$$, you said you wanted to return to a life where you wore glasses. That wish has come half true...」

736:t_1:528.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then this time, I'd like you to take my glasses off, $n...」

736:t_1:529.en:
$n
「Should I ask $$ＡＧ$$ to adjust things so you can go back to your old pilot suit?」

736:t_1:531.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Oh! Are you trying to make a woman say something embarrassing herself!? You quiet type!」

736:t_1:532.en:
$n
「...So I'm still the quiet type after all...」

736:t_1:534.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Fine, $n. Once this battle is over, I'll give you plenty of lessons.」

736:t_1:536.en:
$n
「I want to graduate with everyone too, without having to repeat a year!」

736:t_1:538.en:
$$スズネ$$
(It looks like there's a rough road ahead...)

736:t_1:539.en:
$n
「Let's go, Miss $$スズネ$$. We have to keep our promises to everyone too.」

736:t_1:540.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes... We'll put everything we have on the line.」

736:t_1:541.en:
$n
(Thank you, Miss $$スズネ$$... I'm... really happy I got to be your partner...)

736:t_3:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「The temporary power of $$シンカ$$...! Is this the humans' clever little struggle!?」

736:t_3:5.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「It's useless! Power like this won't work on us!」

736:t_3:8.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「My beloved little sister broke the $$ギアス$$ cast on her through her own strong will!」

736:t_3:9.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「If the power of emotion can break $$ギアス$$, then it should also be able to strengthen $$ギアス$$!」

736:t_3:10.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「You are a mere human!」

736:t_3:11.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「There's no way the likes of you can beat an $$御使い$$ in strength of will!」

736:t_3:12.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Stop this pointless effort! Do you intend to throw your own life away!?」

736:t_3:13.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Exactly! I was prepared to die from the start!」

736:t_3:15.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「You immortals could never believe that.」

736:t_3:16.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「That is the $$御使い$$s' weakness! You do not know the weight of life... its power!」

736:t_3:17.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「You gained eternity, but you cannot overcome the heart of a human prepared to die!」

736:t_3:19.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「You gained eternity and lost the brilliance of a single moment... the meaning of life!」

736:t_3:20.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Now you will receive my final $$ギアス$$... my very life!!」

736:t_2:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is not it, $$ドクトリン$$.」
